test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per Census 2011, what was the population density of Bihar, the most densely populated state in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1102 persons/sq km**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census 2011**, **Bihar** emerged as the most densely populated state in India with a density of **1,102 persons per square kilometer**.
 
• **Population density** is a measurement of population per unit area, typically expressed as the number of people per square kilometer of land area.
 
• During the **2001 Census**, Bihar's density was **881**, indicating a significant growth of **221 persons per sq km** over the decade.
 
• This high density is attributed to the fertile **Gangetic plains**, which support intensive agriculture and a large rural population, making it the most crowded state in the country, surpassing **West Bengal**.
 
• The state represents about **8.6% of India's total population** while occupying only **2.86% of the total land area** of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Statistics from Census 2011**:

 
 
• **National Average**: The average **population density of India** was recorded at **382 persons per sq km**.
 
• **West Bengal**: Previously the most dense state in 2001, it ranked second in 2011 with **1,028 persons per sq km**.
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh**: Recorded the **lowest population density** in India with only **17 persons per sq km**.
 
• **Delhi (NCT)**: Among all States and Union Territories, **Delhi** holds the highest density with **11,320 persons per sq km**.
 
• **Sex Ratio in Bihar**: The figure **918** (mentioned in options) corresponds to the **Sex Ratio** of Bihar, which represents the number of females per 1,000 males.
 
 
 
• **Growth and Literacy**:
 
 
• Bihar recorded a **decadal growth rate** of **25.42%** between 2001 and 2011.
 
• The **literacy rate** of Bihar as per the 2011 Census was **61.80%**, which was the lowest in the country at that time.
